result.summary: Found 3 issues: a card being cut off at the screen edge, a truncated restaurant name, and an inconsistent heart icon styling across cards.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating the horizontal scroll container is not properly contained or clipped.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling carousel properly clips content within screen bounds or add visual affordance (partial peek) intentionally with proper padding.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated and unreadable due to the card being cut off by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width/spacing so text is not clipped, or ensure full card is visible with proper margin from screen edge.

issues.description: The favorite/heart icon has inconsistent background styling between cards - white icon on transparent background for Tokumaru Ramen Bar card vs white icon on dark circular background for the pizza card below.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button styling (background, size, opacity) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
